facts_raw.Focus: Medical devices, diagnostics, public-health preparedness / biothreat response
facts_raw.Capital Type: No guaranteed accelerator equity investment; separate non-dilutive VANTAGE funding solicitation exists

facts_raw.Non-dilutive: Separate development funding program is non-dilutive

facts_raw.Company Required at Application: No, but must incorporate before accelerator starts
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Early- to mid-stage medical device/diagnostic company; prototype/POC and sufficient runway preferred; senior leader must commit to Summit, virtual accelerator and Showcase/Finals.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 公共卫生应急/诊断/监测/生物威胁契合；明确 regulatory pathway、临床价值和商业化能力。

facts_raw.Application Materials: MedTech Innovator core application；后续 pitch events / diligence。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 公开 program email + official application period。

facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司；缺少核心技术/IP、仅做轻量同质化应用或贸易型项目；只有想法、无 MVP/traction 的极早期项目
facts_raw.Notes: Very strong medtech validation channel. Up to 10 companies; virtual program with SF Innovator Summit and US conference events.
